name: u9-mcp-dev
description: U9 OpenAPI (ApiDoc) full-coverage MCP Server development team — WebAPI integration, MCP tool implementation, QA regression and PyPI release.

displayDescription.en: Builds and maintains the U9 MCP Server: integrates all OpenAPI interfaces from ApiDoc, implements MCP tools, runs QA regression, and publishes to PyPI.
displayDescription.zh: 专注用友U9 MCP 开发，将 ApiDoc 全量接口纳入 MCP，含接入、工具实现、测试与发布。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 把用友 ApiDoc【供应链→采购管理】的接口集成进 u9-mcp，先探字段再写工具。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Help me integrate the U9 OpenAPI (ApiDoc) interfaces under Supply Chain > Procurement into u9-mcp — discover fields first, then implement the tool.

quickPrompts.en: Integrate the ApiDoc interfaces under Supply Chain > Procurement into u9-mcp (discover fields first).
quickPrompts.zh: 把用友 ApiDoc【供应链→采购管理】的接口集成进 u9-mcp，先探字段再写工具。

quickPrompts.en: Run the evals regression to confirm the 89 existing tools are not broken.
quickPrompts.zh: 跑一遍 evals 回归，确认现有 89 个工具没有被破坏。

quickPrompts.en: Prepare the 0.3.0 release: update CHANGELOG, build and upload to PyPI.
quickPrompts.zh: 准备 0.3.0 发布：更新 CHANGELOG、构建并上传 PyPI。

profession.zh: 用友 WebAPI 集成工程师
